title: Misting Nozzle Runtime Imbalance
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mister:cycle
| search runtime_sec=*
| stats avg(runtime_sec) as avg_runtime_sec max(runtime_sec) as max_runtime_sec by zone_name nozzle_id
| sort 0 - avg_runtime_sec
description: Ranks zone-nozzle pairss by misting nozzle runtime.
value: Runtime imbalance can expose clogs, poor pressure, or zones receiving much more water than intended.
implementation: Send misting nozzle runtime events to `index=personal` and keep `zone_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of misting nozzle runtime by zone-nozzle pairs.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which zone-nozzle pairss stand out most for misting nozzle runtime.
